articles.title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
articles.snippet: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

articles.title: OKX looks to abstract blockchain mechanics to bring stablecoin balances to everyday consumers
articles.snippet: OKX appears to be designing products to keep the blockchain element abstracted or out of sight for users who simply want to hold digital dollars and use a card.

articles.title: More than 60 U.S. stocks including Nvidia and Tesla are headed onchain. Here’s how it works
articles.snippet: The planned 24/7 venue will offer dozens of tokenized U.S. stocks, with trades conducted against stablecoins through blockchain-based liquidity pools rather than a traditional order book.

articles.title: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year
articles.snippet: The payments giant is planning a major global expansion for its stablecoin cards business, and is exploring tokenized deposits and DeFi use cases, new crypto head Henri Stern said.

articles.title: Paxos’ $3B USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum
articles.snippet: Paxos’ USDG stablecoin is now live on Arbitrum as the network proposes 100 million ARB in incentives to support adoption and liquidity.
